1945, September 15
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, C.F.M. Cap.
St. Michael's Church 225 Jerome Street Brooklyn 7, N.Y. Sept. 15, 1945
Miss Muriel Krausman Detroit, Michigan
Dear Miss Krausman:
God bless you and yours. Many thanks for the air mail yesterday. Glad to hear things are improving with your dear Dad. Thanks be to God for everything.
I am sending you the mourning card for Wm. Murphy and the certifi- cates-blanks-for the two others. Not certain of their names I just made a special enrollment ($1.00 or more) for each of two according to your intention. You can fill out the blanks, etc.
Dear Muriel: .... You tell me you see others so happy .... 0! yes we see such people. . Thank God they exist, though many of those who seem happy-who try to appear so-hardly know just what happiness is. Many do not realiz or stop to use their faculty of reasoning that the very soul of happiness for mortals-those who are to die some day-is hope. Children are happy as a rule because in the mind of any normal child there is always bright star of hope: "Some day I'll be grown up." "I'll be a woman." "I'll be a man." Herein we must imitate the child- ren. But instead of their ideals to be mature-a man or woman-we ought to think over to goal ahead, our eternal destiny-for all Eternity- to be proficient in what in this world we can only taste, so to say Know- ledge of God. Knowledge of anyone who is good means love for same in- as much as we be normal. Knowledge of God, therefore !!!! The aim, the purpose of the rational creature's existence.
Love and God's blessing to all,
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
P.S. -- Simply to be grateful to God for what has done for us, what is doing and promises to do. . What Hope .....!
